reviewer: Parent agent visual inspection of tool-rendered images

checks.name: Desktop overview and selected Graphics scope
checks.evidence: Readable current/prior/change values, visible source locators and group-only labels; CFO order differs from Board.

checks.name: Mobile header, controls and all eight cards
checks.evidence: 390px viewport fits the document; labels and values remain legible in the two-column card grid.

checks.name: Evidence search and formula presentation
checks.evidence: Search result table shows units, disclosure status, notes, source headings and precise locators. Numerical expressions and input IDs are visible in evidence and analytical panels.

checks.name: Separated annual/quarterly amount and ratio charts
checks.evidence: Direct labels, distinct units and zero-baseline bars; quarterly plot labels and source references do not overlap in the corrected screen or print view.

checks.name: Historical guidance and scope
checks.evidence: Q4 actual/prior-guidance comparison separated from historical Q1 FY2027 outlook; GAAP OpEx 6,650 table value versus prose approximately 6,700 identified; dated outlook and non-GAAP comparability notes visible.

checks.name: All seven dashboard PDF pages
checks.evidence: No clipped text, overlapping chart content or orphaned major section headings. Each major report section starts clearly; final page explains omitted interactive ledger and source/FCF conventions.

checks.name: One-page executive summary
checks.evidence: One A4 page; five headlines, three risks, three questions and references legible.

iterations.finding: Initial print layout let quarterly bars overlap source/quarter labels and stranded major section headings.
iterations.resolution: Stage4 builder introduced proportional CSS-variable chart heights and dedicated plot boxes, explicit print page starts, and visible Board units. Revised browser bounds checks and all PDF pages passed.

limitations: Headless Chromium print media and generated PDFs were verified; native OS print dialog was not exercised.
Full interactive evidence ledger is intentionally omitted from printed dashboard and remains available in self-contained HTML and filtered CSV.
